name: PulseStack
title: PulseStack Observability Platform
prompt: Build a comprehensive modern SaaS landing page for PulseStack, a distributed real-time telemetry and cloud observability platform. Include an intelligent dark theme, high-contrast typography, interactive metrics explorer, workflow architecture diagram, transparent cluster pricing toggle (monthly vs annual with savings badge), and enterprise SLA guarantee. Do not invent stock testimonials or placeholder email addresses. Support 375px mobile screens and reduced motion.

name: AuthMatrix
title: AuthMatrix Zero-Trust Identity
prompt: Create a high-security SaaS website for AuthMatrix, an enterprise zero-trust identity and multi-tenant RBAC platform. Sections: sticky top navigation with live security status badge, split hero with interactive token inspection simulator, policy engine feature matrix, compliance credentials grid (SOC2, HIPAA, ISO27001), interactive tier calculator, and technical documentation footer. Use graphite, steel blue, and emerald accents. Avoid generic Lorem Ipsum and fake customer names.

name: FlowOps
title: FlowOps CI/CD Orchestration
prompt: Build a developer-first SaaS website for FlowOps, a cloud-native pipeline orchestration engine with ephemeral preview environments. Include a dark-mode hero with animated syntax pipeline runner, stage dependency visualizer, environment resource allocation calculator, developer quotes with verifiable GitHub handles, and a dual-button call to action. Ensure full keyboard accessibility and valid semantic landmarks.

name: ElenaVance
title: Elena Vance Generative Design Studio
prompt: Build a clean, minimalist portfolio website for Elena Vance, a senior generative design director and computational artist. The site must embody Swiss editorial typography with warm cream and charcoal tones. Sections: masthead navigation with availability indicator, curated case study gallery with category filtering (Installations, Algorithmic Art, Spatial UI), interactive project lightbox modal, design philosophy manifesto, and a direct inquiry contact section with real mailto action.

name: KaitoMori
title: Kaito Mori Systems Architect Portfolio
prompt: Create a technical, high-density portfolio website for Kaito Mori, a distributed systems architect and open-source kernel contributor. Use an austere monospace-accented dark palette (deep zinc, obsidian, and phosphor green). Sections: terminal-inspired header, systems telemetry summary, interactive open-source repository matrix with real commit metrics, peer-reviewed publications list with downloadable abstracts, and cryptographically verifiable contact keys.

name: AriaSterling
title: Aria Sterling Spatial UI Portfolio
prompt: Build an avant-garde design portfolio for Aria Sterling, a spatial UI designer and creative technologist. Incorporate glassmorphic depth layers, subtle frosted glass gradients, interactive before/after interactive prototype comparison sliders, an interactive client retrospective slider, and an accessible contact form with instant local validation.

name: NordicRoast
title: NordicRoast Single-Origin Specialty Coffee
prompt: Build an artisanal direct-to-consumer ecommerce website for NordicRoast, a Copenhagen specialty coffee roastery. Features: header with persistent cart count and slide-over mini-cart drawer, roasting origin selector (Ethiopia Guji, Colombia Huila, Kenya Nyeri), grind profile toggle (Whole Bean, Chemex, Espresso), tasting notes sensory flavor radar, subscription frequency selector with dynamic price recalculation, and checkout summary. Use natural oat, forest pine, and espresso tones.

name: AeroCraft
title: AeroCraft Mechanical Keyboards
prompt: Create a premium boutique ecommerce site for AeroCraft, maker of CNC-machined aluminum mechanical keyboards. Include a top announcement banner, hero with 360-degree interactive chassis angle preview, interactive sound profile switch simulator (Linear Cream vs Tactile Holy Panda vs Clicky Blue), customizable keycap layout selector, shopping cart state management with real-time subtotal/shipping estimation, and customer review cards with verified buyer tags.

name: VerveBotanicals
title: Verve Botanicals Sustainable Skincare
prompt: Build an elegant, clean apothecary ecommerce website for Verve Botanicals. Sections: navigation with announcement bar and currency selector, hero highlighting cold-pressed bioactive serums, interactive diagnostic skin routine quiz that recommends a tailored 3-step regimen, ingredients transparency accordion with botanical sourcing details, and a customer favorites carousel with quick-add functionality. Use soft sage, warm alabaster, and botanical olive colors.

name: TheDispatch
title: The Dispatch Investigative Magazine
prompt: Build an authoritative long-form editorial journalism website for The Dispatch. Design with timeless serif typography, expansive margins, and newspaper grid structure. Features: masthead with current date, edition selector, and reading progress bar; featured investigative cover story with estimated reading time and pull-quotes; categorized article index with tabbed filtering (Geopolitics, Climate Technology, Human Rights); interactive font size adjuster (Standard, Large, Scholar); and newsletter subscription form with privacy confirmation.

name: ChronicleQuarterly
title: Chronicle Quarterly Architectural Journal
prompt: Create a high-end cultural and architectural review publication website for Chronicle Quarterly. Features: bilingual English/French issue toggle, curated visual essay hero with full-bleed architectural photography slots, multi-column editorial layout with interactive sidebar footnotes, author directory with bibliographies, and an interactive print subscription portal with delivery frequency options. Palette: raw newsprint beige, deep ink black, and cadmium orange.

name: SyntaxReview
title: Syntax Review Developer Monograph
prompt: Build a scholarly digital periodical website for Syntax Review, focusing on programming languages, type theory, and software ergonomics. Sections: clean academic header, featured paper breakdown with interactive code playground/snippet viewer, peer-review annotations sidebar, citation export modal (BibTeX / APA), issue archives search with instant query filtering, and scholarly contributor roster. Monospaced and classic serif paired typography.

name: UmamiCraft
title: UmamiCraft Kaiseki Tasting Salon
prompt: Build a serene, atmospheric culinary website for UmamiCraft, an intimate 12-seat Kaiseki tasting salon in Kyoto. Palette of charred cedar, washi paper, and deep gold leaf. Features: zen minimalist header with reservation trigger, seasonal 10-course omakase menu showcase with dietary filter toggles (Pescatarian, Vegan adjustments), interactive table reservation booking form with party size and date selection, sake pairing curation carousel, and guest etiquette guidelines.

name: LArtigiano
title: L'Artigiano Woodfired Pizzeria
prompt: Create a vibrant, rustic digital storefront for L'Artigiano, an authentic Neapolitan woodfired pizzeria and natural wine bar. Include a cheerful Italian header with live oven status indicator, pizza menu organized by base (Rosse vs Bianche vs Speciali) with ingredient badges, interactive build-your-own pizza topping previewer with real-time price updates, wine list with biodynamic organic tags, and click-to-order pickup scheduler.

name: BotanicaTable
title: Botanica Table Farm-to-Table Gastronomy
prompt: Build a sustainable, garden-focused restaurant site for Botanica Table, featuring hyper-seasonal produce from their private organic farm. Sections: navigation with seasonal harvest calendar link, farm hero with chef's philosophy, interactive daily harvest chalkboard that updates displayed dishes based on today's picked crops, private dining inquiry drawer, chef's table wine pairing notes, and directions map placeholder with transport details. Warm terracotta and herb green palette.

name: LuminaHealth
title: LuminaHealth Preventative Cardiology
prompt: Build an authoritative, patient-first website for LuminaHealth, a clinical preventative cardiology and biometric telemetry institute. Palette: clinical sterile white, calm oceanic navy, and pulse cyan. Sections: accessibility-focused header with Emergency 911 disclaimer and direct patient portal login, biometric diagnostic risk calculator (evaluating BP, cholesterol range, and lifestyle factors with clear non-diagnostic disclaimers), clinical leadership directory with credentials and medical school affiliations, patient intake FAQ accordion, and HIPAA-compliant appointment booking request stepper.

name: SynapseCare
title: SynapseCare Neuro-Rehabilitation Platform
prompt: Create a modern, accessible neurological care and cognitive therapy platform website for SynapseCare. Designed with high-contrast accessibility standards (WCAG AAA compliant), large click targets, and a screen-reader friendly structure. Features: top accessibility toolbar (Contrast toggle, Dyslexic font toggle), hero with patient outcome metrics, interactive therapy program finder based on diagnosis (Stroke, TBI, Parkinson's), clinician matching quiz, and accredited insurance provider lookup table.

name: AuraPediatrics
title: Aura Pediatrics Telehealth Clinic
prompt: Build a warm, reassuring healthcare website for Aura Pediatrics, offering pediatric telehealth and in-person family developmental wellness. Incorporate soft sky blue, gentle peach, and calm navy colors. Sections: friendly top bar with after-hours triage hotline, cheerful hero with age-range care tracks (Infant 0-1, Toddler 1-4, Child 5-12, Teen), interactive vaccine schedule tracker with age selector, parent testimonial quotes with verified patient parent consent, and instant same-day telemedicine booking module.

name: ApexTreasury
title: Apex Treasury Global Liquidity
prompt: Build an institutional financial technology website for Apex Treasury, a multi-currency treasury liquidity management and algorithmic FX hedging platform. Palette: deep obsidian, brushed platinum, and sovereign gold. Sections: live FX ticker tape with simulated tick updates, split hero with real-time liquidity depth visualization, interactive cross-currency interest rate parity calculator, enterprise compliance and regulatory clearance badges (FCA, FinCEN, BaFin), tier comparison table, and request-for-demo modal.

name: StrataCap
title: StrataCap Quantitative Venture Capital
prompt: Create a sleek, data-driven financial website for StrataCap, an algorithmic venture capital firm backing foundational deep-tech companies. Features: clean monochromatic palette with electric emerald highlights, real-time fund performance metric cards (IRR, TVPI, DPI), interactive portfolio company quadrant chart with sector filtering (Robotics, Quantum, Biotech, Space), LP investor portal login gateway simulation, and general partner investment thesis manifesto.

name: VeritasWealth
title: Veritas Fiduciary Wealth Advisory
prompt: Build a dignified, trustworthy wealth management website for Veritas Wealth Advisory. Features: fiduciary oath statement hero, interactive multi-generational retirement and estate planning wealth trajectory simulator with compound growth slider, wealth preservation strategy pillars, advisor team credentials (CFA, CFP), fee transparency comparison vs commission-based brokerages, and confidential consultation scheduler. Navy, cream, and champagne gold palette.

name: VanguardCreative
title: Vanguard Creative Brand & Spatial Agency
prompt: Build an award-winning creative agency portfolio for Vanguard Creative, specialists in luxury brand identity and spatial retail installations. Bold brutalist editorial layout with large variable typography, high contrast black-and-white foundation, and acid lime accents. Sections: oversized typographic hero with interactive magnetic cursor follower effect, showcase of iconic client campaigns with full-screen video/image mockups and project metrics, interactive capabilities accordion, client roster marquee, and project brief builder form.

name: HyperionDigital
title: Hyperion Digital Venture Studio
prompt: Create a cutting-edge agency website for Hyperion Digital, a venture studio that designs, builds, and scales digital hardware and software products. Sections: sticky nav with active project count, split hero with interactive sprint velocity timeline, interactive studio venture portfolio with filterable stage tabs (Ideation, Incubation, Growth, Spinoff), tech stack radar, client testimonials with verifiable company links, and venture partnership application form. Deep charcoal and electric violet styling.

name: MonolithLabs
title: Monolith Labs Creative Computing Agency
prompt: Build an experimental digital agency site for Monolith Labs, specializing in real-time creative computing, AI interaction models, and interactive installations. Features: dark monospace aesthetic with interactive terminal prompt, showcase of experimental research prototypes, audio-reactive simulation playground demo, interactive team roster with digital avatars, and collaboration inquiry console. Carbon, gunmetal, and laser blue colors.

name: KereStudio
title: Kéré Studio Mass Timber Architecture
prompt: Build an evocative architectural portfolio site for Kéré Studio, pioneers in sustainable mass timber and circular public architecture. Use raw linen, charred cedar, and forest moss tones. Sections: tranquil minimalist header, full-width project hero with cross-laminated timber structural drawings, interactive projects directory filterable by typology (Civic, Cultural, Residential, Landscape), interactive carbon offset impact calculator per square meter, material taxonomy glossary, and studio monograph request form.

name: TadaoForm
title: Tadao Form Minimalist Concrete Architecture
prompt: Create a serene, monolithic website for Tadao Form, an architectural atelier crafting exposed raw concrete residential pavilions and contemplative sanctuaries. Features: austere typography, generous negative space, split hero with light-and-shadow angle toggle (Morning, Noon, Twilight light studies on concrete surfaces), gallery of completed pavilions with blueprints modal, architectural philosophy essay, and commission inquiry form. Mineral grey, matte charcoal, and stark white palette.

name: AtelierNord
title: Atelier Nord Alpine Passive Architecture
prompt: Build a modern alpine architecture practice website for Atelier Nord, focusing on zero-emission passive houses in extreme mountain topographies. Sections: header with current alpine weather altitude widget, hero with snow-capped elevation rendering, building envelope thermal efficiency visualizer (R-value, triple glazing, heat recovery), interactive project map/grid with elevation meters, sustainability certifications (Passivhaus Institut, Minergie), and press review downloads. Glacier white, slate, and alpine pine palette.

name: GridMatrix
title: GridMatrix Renewable Microgrid Telemetry
prompt: Build an industrial renewable energy dashboard web application for GridMatrix. Include a real-time microgrid telemetry view with solar PV generation, wind turbine speed, battery BESS state of charge (percentage bar and degradation index), live kilowatt flow schematic, interactive alert threshold controller, historical energy generation chart toggle (24h / 7d / 30d), and automated diesel generator failover switch simulator. Industrial dark theme with neon yellow and cyber green indicators.

name: FleetPulse
title: FleetPulse Autonomous EV Telematics
prompt: Create a mission-control fleet management dashboard for FleetPulse, an autonomous commercial EV logistics operator. Features: top status bar with total active vehicles, route completion rate, and fleet state of charge; interactive live vehicle list with search, status filters (En Route, Charging, Idle, Maintenance), and sort by battery percentage; vehicle detail telemetry drawer with motor temperature, tire pressure, and lidar diagnostics; and dispatch routing command controls.

name: CloudSentry
title: CloudSentry Kubernetes Cluster Radar
prompt: Build a high-density Kubernetes cluster monitoring dashboard for CloudSentry. Sections: cluster health header with node count and error budget burn rate; interactive node topology map (Master vs Worker nodes with CPU/Memory saturation bars); live pod status table with container restarts and OOMKill indicators; latency percentile distribution toggle (p50, p95, p99); and quick-action cluster restart drill-down confirmation modal with safety guard. Deep charcoal and glowing amber aesthetic.

name: FormaAudio
title: FormaAudio Spatial Headphones 3D Product
prompt: Build a luxury 3D product showcase website for FormaAudio H1, high-end planar magnetic spatial audio headphones. Features: interactive 3D WebGL product canvas allowing the user to rotate the headphones in 3D space, orbit controls, finish customizer (Matte Obsidian, Brushed Titanium, Champagne Gold) with immediate material update in the 3D scene, exploded driver acoustic breakdown tabs, technical frequency response curve graph, and interactive pre-order configuration cart drawer.

name: ChronosWatch
title: Chronos Tourbillon 3D Horology
prompt: Create an opulent luxury horology showcase for Chronos Atelier, presenting their handcrafted titanium tourbillon timepiece. Features: real-time 3D rendered watch case with rotating tourbillon escapement simulation, interactive lighting angle controls, strap selector (Alligator Leather, Milanese Mesh, Titanium Link) updating the 3D model accents, intricate complication movement specifications, and appointment booking form for Geneva salon viewings. Deep midnight blue and rose gold palette.

name: VeloceBike
title: Veloce Monocoque Carbon Bike 3D
prompt: Build a high-performance 3D product website for Veloce Strata, a wind-tunnel optimized monocoque carbon fiber road racing bicycle. Sections: 3D bike viewport with camera presets (Front Aero Profile, Bottom Bracket Stiffener, Cockpit Integration), interactive groupset configurator (Shimano Dura-Ace vs SRAM Red AXS) calculating overall bike weight in real-time, wind-tunnel drag coefficient bar comparison, and size geometry calculator (48cm to 60cm). Carbon black, chalk white, and racing red colors.

name: NebulaUniverse
title: Nebula Universe Particle Simulation
prompt: Build an immersive interactive WebGL experience website for Nebula Universe, an astronomical visualization project. Features: full-screen interactive particle nebula canvas with thousands of GPU points responding to mouse velocity, interactive cosmic parameter controls (Particle Density, Gravitational Pull, Color Temperature from Infrared to Ultraviolet), audio toggle with generative ambient synthesizer oscillator, chapter narrative navigation, and celestial fact cards modal. Deep cosmic void palette.

name: AetherFluid
title: Aether Fluid Dynamics Interactive Canvas
prompt: Create a mesmerizing interactive WebGL experiential website for Aether, an interactive real-time fluid simulation and digital art canvas. Features: real-time Navier-Stokes fluid physics shader simulation reacting to cursor drag and touch gestures, interactive fluid color palette picker (Neon Bioluminescence, Molten Lava, Ocean Abyssal), viscosity and vorticity sliders, capture screenshot download button of user fluid artwork, and digital gallery of curated fluid moments. Obsidian, neon cyan, and magenta highlights.

name: ChronoTunnel
title: ChronoTunnel Retro-Futuristic Warp Tunnel
prompt: Build a high-energy interactive WebGL experience for ChronoTunnel, a retro-futuristic infinite warp tunnel with synthwave aesthetics. Features: three-dimensional perspective wireframe tunnel shader with infinite forward velocity, warp speed accelerator key/button, reactive beat pulsation synced to a built-in synthwave audio loop, color mode switcher (Outrun Sunset, Matrix Phosphor, Cyberpunk Night), and high score challenge timer measuring user reflex in dodging virtual gate obstacles.
